notes: The library page links to libcatalog.ugent.be/nde with vid=32RUG_INST:32RUG_INST, which resolves via CNAME to eu06.primo.exlibrisgroup.com. eu06 is outside the sixteen listed regions; all sixteen returned empty bodies, while eu06 returned uresolver_content with 4 context_service elements (getFullTxt, e.g. SpringerLink) and no full_text_indicator key.

notes: The library homepage links to a VuFind OPAC (opac.ub.lmu.de) whose 'Artikel & mehr' tab is a Primo index search module, not an Alma catalogue. The BVB SFX instance sfx_ubm is live and resolved a Nature 2020 request into a full-text redirect (Gale, LMU Shibboleth).

notes: The library homepage's catalogue is OCLC WorldCat Discovery (uni-heidelberg.on.worldcat.org); no Primo/Alma found. The ReDI resolver from Zotero still exists but redirects to www-fr.redi-bw.de and returns 403 off campus, so a WorldCat link resolver may now replace it.
